product_family: Forethought multi-agent AI platform for customer support: Solve Agent (omnichannel resolution), Triage Agent (ticket classification), Discover Agent (insights), QA Agent, and Agentic AI Copilot across chat, email, voice, Slack, and headless channels.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Compliance: SOC 2 Type II ... Resources: SOC2 Audit Report (available on request via the Trust Center). Security page: 'certified for SOC 2' with annual Type II audits.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Compliance: HIPAA ... Resources include 'HIPAA Audit Report'. FAQ: 'HIPAA Compliant?' Security page: controls aligned with HIPAA requirements.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001: 'independently audited and certified to meet compliance standards' (stated on the Security & Compliance page). Note: not surfaced on the Trust Center compliance list, but asserted on forethought.ai/platform/security.

certifications.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Compliance: 'NIST Cybersecurity Framework' listed under the Trust Center Compliance section.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Compliance: 'GDPR' listed in Trust Center. Security page: 'Data Processing Agreement (DPA) reflects the requirements of the GDPR and CCPA'.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: Compliance: 'CCPA COMPLIANT' shown on the Trust Center; DPA reflects CCPA requirements.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: Trust Center FAQ explicitly lists the question 'FedRAMP compliant?' indicating it is addressed but not held as a certification; no FedRAMP authorization evidence found.

privacy.ai_training_note: Forethought trains models individually per customer on that customer's own past tickets and help-center content ('Trained on Your Data'). It does NOT train shared/foundation models across clients, supporting per-customer data isolation. The product purpose is per-tenant model training, not pooling customer data into a shared model.
privacy.data_region: Personal information may be stored and processed in your region or the United States. Post-acquisition data may run on Zendesk AWS infrastructure across countries where Zendesk or its service providers maintain facilities.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Data encrypted at rest; TLS in transit.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Regular pen tests with trusted security vendors; projects receive security-design reviews and threat models. Pen Test report available on the Trust Center.

security.name: Bug bounty
security.value: Private, invite-only bug bounty program via HackerOne; uninvited reports accepted at security+bbp@forethought.ai.

security.name: Data redaction
security.value: Automatic PII/PHI/financial data redaction on ingestion (best-effort); original sensitive data securely deleted within 24 hours. 300M+ interactions redacted.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Role-based access controls, customer-specific data segmentation, SSO, MFA-enforced remote access, restricted encryption-key access.

security.name: Secret management
security.value: Production secrets managed with AWS tooling.

security.name: Resilience
security.value: Disaster Recovery test and results, incident response policies, and data center access reviews documented in Trust Center controls.

products.name: Solve Agent (Omnichannel AI Agent)
products.data_scope: Ingests customer tickets and help-center content; processes end-user conversations across chat, email, voice, Slack, headless. Acts as data processor on customer data.
products.notes: Per-customer model training; PII/PHI redacted by default.

products.name: Triage Agent
products.data_scope: Processes inbound ticket content to classify, prioritize, and tag. Pre-built or custom per-customer models.

products.name: Discover Agent
products.data_scope: Analyzes aggregate support interactions to surface knowledge gaps and recommendations.

products.name: QA Agent
products.data_scope: Scores human agent tickets; processes conversation transcripts.
products.notes: Operates on customer ticket data as processor.

products.name: Agentic AI Copilot
products.data_scope: Real-time suggestions inside the helpdesk; reads ticket context.
products.notes: Embedded in existing helpdesk; no data leaves customer tenant model scope.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise / sales-led (Request Demo, custom pricing; no public self-serve tier).
compare.data_residency: Customer region or US; AWS-hosted, expanding onto Zendesk AWS infrastructure post-acquisition.

flags: Acquired by Zendesk (2025) — 'Forethought is now part of Zendesk'; data infrastructure and policies are migrating to Zendesk, which may change subprocessor/residency details over time.
ISO 27001 is asserted on Forethought's Security page but is not listed on the Trust Center compliance panel; SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, NIST, GDPR, CCPA are consistent across both.
Most detailed reports (SOC 2, HIPAA, Pen Test, security whitepapers) are gated behind Trust Center 'Request access' rather than public.
